# Main Street

> Main Street is an open-source toolkit for building a professional small-business website for about $12 a year. The business owner updates the site by chatting with any AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar): the AI prepares every change on a preview copy, the owner reviews it on their phone, and says "ship it" to make it live. No page builder, no monthly fees, no developer on retainer.

## What it is

- A **site template** (`template/`): a fast, accessible small-business website with a setup wizard, business-type presets, and plain-English guides.
- A **scaffolder** (`scripts/new-site.mjs`): turns the template into a new customer site repo in one command.
- An **AI knowledge base** (`template/rules/`, `template/features/`, `template/presets/`, `template/CLAUDE.md`): instructions so any AI assistant can safely maintain the site.
- **Docs**: [the $12/year stack](docs/the-12-dollar-stack.md), [setup guide](template/docs/setup-guide.md), [connect your AI](template/docs/connect-your-ai.md), [API keys](template/docs/api-keys.md), [everyday examples](template/docs/examples.md), [owner quickstart](template/docs/owner-quickstart.md), [for agencies](docs/for-agencies.md).

## Who it is for

Small business owners (plumbers, salons, bakeries, restaurants, shops) who want a professional website without learning a page builder or paying monthly fees, and the agencies, freelancers, or tech-savvy friends who set sites up for them.

## How updates work (the golden loop)

1. The owner tells their AI assistant what they want, in plain words.
2. The AI prepares the change on a **preview copy** (the staging site).
3. The owner opens the preview link on their phone and checks it.
4. The owner says **"ship it"** and the live site updates in about a minute.

Nothing goes live without the owner seeing and approving it first.

## Key vocabulary

- **Preview copy**: the staging site where every change is prepared and reviewed first. Never edit the live site directly.
- **Ship it**: the owner's approval phrase. It means merge the preview copy to production.
- **The $12/year stack**: the cost model. About $12 a year for the domain name; hosting, CDN, and analytics run on free tiers (Cloudflare Pages, Resend, Cloudflare Analytics).
- **Graceful degradation**: if an API key is missing, the feature quietly steps back (visitors see an email address instead of a form) and the page never breaks.

## Technical facts

- Static site built with Vite; plain HTML/CSS, no framework.
- Deploys on Cloudflare Pages: `main` branch is production, `staging` branch is the preview site.
- Contact form runs on a Cloudflare Pages Function with spam protection optional.
- MIT licensed. Repository: https://github.com/davegelinas/main-street
